prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean spray (sunless) tanning or UV/tanning beds? And which part of Columbus are you in or near (zip or neighborhood)?

If you want a quick answer now, here’s how to pick the best salon and a ready-to-use search method:

What to look for
- Type: spray (sunless) vs UV beds — most pros recommend spray for safety and even results.
- Technician skill: ask for photos of previous clients and for certifications in airbrush or solution use.
- Hygiene and equipment: clean booths, disposable nose/foot covers, fresh solution, modern spray or bed equipment.
- Products and customization: ability to select shade, undertone, prep and aftercare instructions.
- Reviews and photos: recent Google/Yelp/Facebook reviews and before/after images.
- Patch test and consultation: reputable places offer a consultation and a small test spray if needed.
- Price and packages: ask about single sessions vs packages/memberships and cancellation policy.

How to find top salons near you (copy-paste this search)
- Google: “best spray tanning near [your neighborhood or ZIP], Columbus OH”
- Yelp filter: sort by “Highest Rated” and read recent reviews with photos
- Facebook or Instagram: look for before/after images and client comments

If you tell me which type (spray or UV) and your neighborhood or ZIP code, I’ll suggest 3–5 well-reviewed salons in your area and what to ask when booking.
